name: tailord
description: Tailord monorepo — root dev orchestration only. App dependencies live in frontend/ and backend/.

scripts.dev:servers: concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,magenta "cd backend && uv run uvicorn app.main:app --reload" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.dev:api: node scripts/dev-preflight.mjs --target=api && cd backend && uv run uvicorn app.main:app --reload
scripts.dev:web: node scripts/dev-preflight.mjs --target=web && npm --prefix frontend run dev
scripts.dev:approve: cd backend && uv run python dev_approve.py
